naslov: EuroCup roundup: Flynn erupts for 28 as Bahcesehir survives a thriller
tekst:
By Eurohoops team/ info@eurohoops.net
Bahcesehir recorded a victory on their home court in the fifth round of the BKT EuroCup, defeating PAOK 84-81.
In a thrilling match in Istanbul, the decision came in the final moments, with Malachi Flynn winning a direct duel against Cedi Osman.
PAOK had a chance to reach overtime at the end, after winning the fourth quarter 23-11, but Breein Tyree missed a three-pointer in the last second, allowing the home team to celebrate.
Malachi Flynn scored 28 points for the home team, Marcquise Reed added 17, and Tyler Cavanaugh contributed 11. For PAOK, Cedi Osman was outstanding again with 30 points, Marcus Foster added 20, and Kyle Alexander had 12.
Victories for Manresa, Ulm and Frankfurt
Manresa achieved their third win in the competition, defeating the home team Balkan in Botevgrad 76-65, who still remain winless.
JD Notae scored 22 points for Manresa, Eric Vila Martinez added 13, and Lucas Beaufort had ten points. For Balkan, Javante McCoy returned after an injury and finished the game with 21 points, while Konstantin Toshkov added 14.
At the same time, Ulm celebrated a victory on the road against Lietkabelis with a score of 86-68.
Jaylen Sims had 13 points for the winning team, Adam Atamna 12, and Michael Rataj also had 12. For Lietkabelis, only Keondre Kennedy with 16 and Alexander Schumacher with 14 points reached double figures.
An excellent performance was also delivered by Frankfurt, who defeated Cluj Napoca 113-97 on their home court.
The German team had six players in double figures, with Judah Mintz and Till Pape leading with 17 points. On the other side, Otis Livingston had a double-double with 23 points and ten assists, while Christian Bishop added 15.
Olivari’s late triple lifts Trento, Bosna wins in Rome
Trento edged Buducnost 94–92 at home as Quincy Olivari knocked down the game-winning three-pointer with one second remaining.
Olivari finished with 21 points, while Darius Brown added 18 points and 12 assists. Axel Bouteille led Buducnost with 17 points, and Juwan Morgan recorded 14 points and 13 rebounds.
After beating Bahcesehir in the previous round, Bosna TH Telecom claimed another impressive win, defeating BC Roma 85–80 on the road.
Reggie Perry led the visitors with 25 points and six rebounds, while Shawn Pipes added 17 points and Gary Browne contributed 13. Kelly Olynyk paced Roma with 17 points and eight rebounds, while Nico Mannion and Erik Stevenson scored 16 apiece.
